en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a steep, rocky hillside covered with dense vegetation and garden terraces, with a small house and a pointed, turret‑like structure on the Schlossberg hill overlooking a town and valley below. At the bottom margin there is printed text identifying the view, and handwritten cursive text across the lower part of the image. A small handwritten date "1905" appears in the upper right corner.
